Create a small synthetic SpatialData store

Source: R/demo.R
sdata_demo.Rd

Writes a store with one Points element, transcripts, of 20 genes in two spatial regions: the left half is enriched for genes A0-A9, the right half for B0-B9. A two-topic model has real structure to recover, which makes it a fast fixture for the vignette and for trying the pipeline (seconds, a few MB). Coordinates live in one identity-registered coordinate system, global.

Usage

sdata_demo(
  out,
  n_points = 60000L,
  size = 200,
  n_genes = 20L,
  seed = 0L,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  python = NULL,
  log = tempfile("sdata_demo", fileext = ".log")
)

Arguments

out

Path of the .zarr store to create.

n_points

Number of transcripts.

size

Side length of the square field.

n_genes

Number of genes (half A*, half B*).

seed

Random seed.

overwrite

Replace out if it exists.

python

Interpreter override; see punkst_setup().

log

Log file.

Value

out, invisibly.

Examples

# Requires a Python interpreter with spatialdata; skipped otherwise.
tryCatch(
    sdata_demo(file.path(tempdir(), "demo.zarr"), n_points = 200L),
    error = function(e) message("spatialdata not available: ", conditionMessage(e)))
